# Gradient editor (`gradient-editor`)

Multi-stop gradient with colour and opacity stops.

Group: Pickers. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/pickers';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createGradientEditor` (types in `dist/web/pickers/gradientEditor.d.ts`): `.mh-gradient-editor`: a preview track with a draggable `.mh-gradient-editor__stop` per colour stop (`role="slider"`: arrow keys move it, Shift by ten, Delete removes it). Pressing the track adds a stop with the colour found there. The selected stop is edited below: position, removal and a `.mh-color-picker` with opacity, so each stop carries both a colour and an opacity.

```ts
export function createGradientEditor(options: GradientEditorOptions = {}): GradientEditorHandle;

export interface GradientEditorOptions {
  /** At least two stops (default: the theme-neutral black to white). */
  stops?: readonly GradientStop[];
  /** Direction in degrees for the CSS output and preview (default 90, left to right). */
  angle?: number;
  /** Shows an angle entry (default false). */
  showAngle?: boolean;
  /** Swatches for the stop colour picker (`false` hides them). */
  swatches?: readonly (string | ColorSwatch)[] | false;
  /** Accessible name (default "Gradient"). */
  label?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** While dragging or editing. */
  onInput?: (stops: GradientStop[], angle: number) => void;
  /** When a change is committed. */
  onChange?: (stops: GradientStop[], angle: number) => void;
}

export interface GradientEditorHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  picker: ColorPickerHandle;
  getStops(): GradientStop[];
  setStops(stops: readonly GradientStop[]): void;
  getAngle(): number;
  setAngle(angle: number): void;
  /** The gradient as a CSS `linear-gradient(...)`. */
  css(): string;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface ColorPickerHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getValue(): string;
  /** Sets the colour without calling the callbacks; unparseable text is ignored. */
  setValue(value: string): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createGradientEditor } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const preview = document.createElement('div');
preview.style.cssText = 'height: 96px; border-radius: var(--mh-radius-lg)';

const sunrise = createGradientEditor({
  label: 'Sunrise light',
  showAngle: true,
  angle: 90,
  stops: [
    { offset: 0, color: '#1a1446' },
    { offset: 40, color: '#c2457a' },
    { offset: 100, color: '#ffb35c' },
  ],
  onInput: () => (preview.style.background = sunrise.css()),
});
preview.style.background = sunrise.css();

document.body.append(preview, sunrise.el);
```

## React API

`GradientEditor` (types in `dist/react/pickers.d.ts`): `createGradientEditor` in a host; `stops`, `angle` and `disabled` follow the props.

export function GradientEditor({ className, stops, angle, onInput, onChange, disabled, showAngle, swatches, label }: GradientEditorProps);

export interface GradientEditorProps extends Omit<GradientEditorOptions, 'onInput' | 'onChange'> {

  onInput?: (stops: GradientStop[], angle: number) => void;
  onChange?: (stops: GradientStop[], angle: number) => void;
}

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { GradientEditor } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import { gradientCss, type GradientStop } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function GradientEditorExample() {
  const [stops, setStops] = useState<GradientStop[]>([
    { offset: 0, color: '#1a1446' },
    { offset: 40, color: '#c2457a' },
    { offset: 100, color: '#ffb35c' },
  ]);
  const [angle, setAngle] = useState(90);
  return (
    <>
      <div style={{ height: 96, borderRadius: 'var(--mh-radius-lg)', background: gradientCss(stops, angle) }} />
      <GradientEditor
        label="Sunrise light"
        showAngle
        stops={stops}
        angle={angle}
        onInput={(next, nextAngle) => {
          setStops(next);
          setAngle(nextAngle);
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}
```
